info.description: The Selling Partner API for Promotions provides programmatic access to promotion management functionality for selling partners on Amazon. This API enables selling partners to create and manage promotions.
info.title: The Selling Partner API for Promotions

get.description: Search and filter promotions based on various criteria. Returns a paginated list of promotion summaries.

parameters.name: marketplaceIds
parameters.description: A comma-delimited list of Amazon marketplace identifiers for the request. Refer [Marketplace IDs](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/marketplace-ids) to find your marketplace.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale code constructed from ISO 639 language code and ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard of country codes separated by an underscore character.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: A comma-delimited list of promotion status values to filter promotion.

parameters.name: endDateAfter
parameters.description: Filter promotions with end date after this timestamp. Zoned Datetime in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 1970-01-01T00:00:00-07:00).

parameters.description: A token to fetch a certain page when there are multiple pages worth of results. The value of this token is fetched from the `pagination` returned in the API response. In the absence of the token value from the query parameter, the API returns the first page of the result

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: Specifies which promotion revision(s) to include in search results. Controls whether to query published revisions, latest revisions, or both.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Query against latest revision of promotions. Returns promotions based on their latest revision state. This will skip promotions where the query matched only its published revision.
Query against published revisions of promotions. Returns only promotions that have been published. This will skip promotions where the query matched only its latest revision.
Query against published and latest revisions. This provides the complete state including both published and latest revision promotions.

get.description: Retrieves details of a specified promotion.

parameters.name: promotionId
parameters.description: The promotion identifier.

parameters.name: includedData
parameters.description: A comma-delimited list of data sets to include in the response. Use this parameter to optimize response payload by including only the data you need.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Include promotion level issues and warnings in the response. If not specified, the 'issues' field will be omitted from the response even if issues exist for the promotion. If this field is specified without 'SELECTION', then item level issues will not be returned in the response. To get item level issues as well, specify both 'SELECTION' and 'ISSUES' in the query parameters, or use the paginated /selections API.

Include selectionDetails field within the 'selection' object, containing item-level information such as benefits, budgets, and other details. If not specified, the 'selection' field will contain only minimal metadata (selectionId, type, and optionally revisionId). Item issues are only populated if both 'SELECTION' and 'ISSUES' are specified in the query parameters, or use the /promotions/{promotionId}/selections/{selectionId} API.
Include customer segment targeting information in the response. If not specified, the 'customerSegments' field will be omitted from the response.

Item.description: An item in the Amazon catalog for promotion selection with optional item-level configurations.

asin.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) is the unique identifier for an item in the Amazon catalog.

Selection.description: Defines which products qualify for the benefit, allowing either specific items to be selected by ASIN or the entire catalog with optional exclusions. Defaults to latest revision when revisionId is not provided.

selectionId.description: Unique identifier for this selection configuration. Note: This field is absent when type is CATALOG.

revisionId.description: Revision identifier for the selection. Defaults to latest revision when revisionId is not provided.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Select all items in the catalog with optional exclusions.
Select specific items by ASIN.

selectionDetails.description: Detailed selection information. Presence varies by endpoint: always included in /promotions/{promotionId}/selections/{selectionId}, conditionally included in /promotions/{promotionId} when 'SELECTION' is in includedData, never included in /promotions. See endpoint documentation for details.

SelectionDetails.description: Detailed selection information including items, rules, issues, and pagination.

rules.description: Rule configuration for catalog-based selections. Only valid when type is CATALOG.

issues.description: Item-level validation issues for items in this selection. Only present when 'ISSUES' are included in includedData query parameter.

example.message: The SKU provided is not valid

items.description: List of specific items to include. Only valid when type is ITEMS (maximum 100 items).

pagination.description: Pagination metadata for navigating through selection items.

excludedItems.description: Items to exclude from the catalog selection (maximum 100 items).

Schedule.description: Configuration defining a promotion's start and end dates with optional event association.

startDate.description: Promotion start date and time. Zoned Datetime in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 1970-01-01T00:00:00-07:00).

endDate.description: Promotion end date and time. Zoned Datetime in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 1970-01-01T00:00:00-07:00).

eventId.description: Optional event identifier to associate the promotion with a specific event. For event promotions, this field contains the event name when available (e.g., "Prime Day"). For historic event promotions, this field may contain "EVENT" as a placeholder until future releases of the API.

Budget.description: Budget configuration for promotion or item-level spending limits.

type.description: Budget type - monetary amount or unit-based.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Budget specified as a monetary amount.
Budget specified as a number of units.

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 format currency code. Required when type is AMOUNT.

CustomerSegment.description: Segment configuration for targeting specific customer cohorts. When segmentType is BRAND, segmentId contains the segment/audience id and segmentDetails.brandSegmentDetails must be provided. When segmentType is PROGRAM, segmentId contains the program name (e.g., PRIME_EXCLUSIVE, MOM, STUDENT etc).

segmentId.description: Segment identifier. For BRAND: segment/audience id. For PROGRAM: program name (e.g., PRIME_EXCLUSIVE, MOM, STUDENT etc).

segmentDetails.description: Additional segment-specific details. Required for BRAND segments type.

CustomerSegmentType.description: Segment type for targeting specific customer cohorts.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Brand Tailored Audience targeting customers interested in specific brands.
Program based targeting for specific customer programs like Prime, Reorder and Save, etc.

CustomerSegmentDetails.description: Additional segment type-specific details. Use the appropriate property based on segmentType.

brandSegmentDetails.description: Brand segment details (required when segmentType is BRAND).

BrandSegmentDetails.description: Additional details specific to BRAND segments type.

Discount.description: Discount configuration shared across benefit types.

type.description: Method used to calculate the discount amount.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Discount applied as a percentage off the original price.
Discount applied as a fixed amount off the original price.
Item is provided free of charge. Only applicable for BASKET_BUILDING promotion type.

percentOff.description: Percentage discount value (1-100). Only valid when type is PERCENTAGE_OFF.

amountOff.description: Amount off value. Only valid when type is AMOUNT_OFF.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Required when type is AMOUNT_OFF.

QuantityThreshold.description: Quantity-based purchase conditions for basket building promotions.

type.description: Determines how the quantity requirement is evaluated: at least a certain number, or for every group of items.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Customer must purchase at least the specified quantity of items.
Benefit applies for every group of specified quantity purchased (e.g., for each 2 items).

quantity.description: Number of items required to meet this purchase condition.

AmountThreshold.description: Amount-based purchase conditions for basket building promotions. Customers must spend a minimum dollar amount.

type.description: Type of amount requirement. Only AT_LEAST is supported for spend-based conditions.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Customer must spend at least the specified dollar amount.

currency.description: Minimum spend amount customers must meet.

PurchaseCondition.description: Specifies minimum purchase requirements using quantity-based or amount-based conditions for basket building promotions. Used in purchase requirements and multi-tier benefit configurations to specify conditions within those configurations. Exactly one of quantityThreshold or amountThreshold must be specified.

quantityThreshold.description: Quantity-based purchase requirement. Specify this for item count conditions.

amountThreshold.description: Amount-based purchase requirement. Specify this for minimum spend conditions.

PurchaseRequirements.description: Purchase requirements that customers must meet to qualify for basket building promotions. Contains the eligibility selection (what to buy), purchase condition (how much to buy), and optional claim code. Represents the 'Buy X' portion of Buy X Get Y promotions.

selection.description: Selection defining which items customers must purchase to qualify for the promotion. References the eligibility product set. This selection only contains selectionId, revisionId, and type; the selectionDetails field is not included. For some BASKET_BUILDING promotions, this selection may be the same as the benefit selection when purchase requirements and benefits apply to the same set of items.

condition.description: Minimum purchase requirement specifying either quantity of items or total spend amount that customers must meet to qualify. For multi-tier BASKET_BUILDING promotions, this represents the first tier purchase condition. Additional tier conditions are defined in benefit.additionalTiers.

claimCode.description: Optional claim code customers must enter to access the promotion. When present, the promotion is code-gated and only available to customers who provide this code.

ClaimCode.description: Claim code configuration for accessing the promotion.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: A 6-12 digit claim-code can be used by multiple customers to redeem the promotion.

Individual claim codes that are unique per customer. This is a placeholder value indicating the promotion contains individual claim codes. Note: The actual code value is not available through this API.

value.description: The actual claim code (6-12 alphanumeric uppercase). Required when type is GROUP.

BenefitTier.description: Defines a progressive (multi-tier) benefit tier that applies when customers exceed a higher purchase quantity for basket building promotions. Each tier specifies a purchase condition and corresponding enhanced discount.

purchaseCondition.description: Purchase condition that must be met to receive this tier's enhanced discount.

Merchandising.description: Merchandising configuration for displaying promotions on the retail website.

displayOnWebsite.description: Controls whether the promotion badge and details are displayed on the product detail pages as well as search results on the retail website.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Promotion will be displayed on the retail website.
Promotion will not be displayed on the retail website.

ItemBenefit.description: Item-level benefit configuration with pricing options.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Item is offered at a fixed price.
Item is offered at a discounted price based on discount configuration.

discount.description: Discount configuration when using DISCOUNTED_PRICE type.

perCustomerUses.description: Maximum uses per customer for this item benefit.

discount.description: Discount configuration for the promotion. For multi-tier BASKET_BUILDING promotions, this represents the first tier discount. Additional tier discounts are defined in additionalTiers.

benefitQuantity.description: Quantity of items from the benefit selection that receive the discount after customer satisfies purchase conditions. This property is specific to BASKET BUILDING promotions.

perCustomerUses.description: Maximum uses per customer for this promotion.

stacking.description: Whether this benefit can be stacked with other promotions.

additionalTiers.description: Progressive discount tiers offering increased benefits as customers purchase more. For example: buy 2 get 10% off, buy 3 get 15% off. For multi-tier BASKET_BUILDING promotions, each tier specifies additional purchase conditions and corresponding discounts beyond the first tier (defined in benefit.discount and purchaseRequirements.condition).

PromotionType.description: Categorizes promotions by their discount application rules and eligibility criteria.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Basket building promotion allows customers to receive a discount on a product (Y) by performing another action, usually purchasing a product (X).
General discount promotion applied to eligible items.
Price discount promotion offering reduced prices on eligible items.
Coupon-based promotion requiring a shopper action for redemption.

Pagination.description: When a request produces a response that returns unbounded results, pagination occurs. This means the entire response is divided into individual pages. To retrieve the right page, you must pass the `nextToken` as the `paginationToken` query parameter in the subsequent request. When there are no more pages to fetch, the `Pagination` key will be absent from the response. When a `Pagination` object is present, it should contain `nextToken` as non-null value

nextToken.description: A token that can be used to fetch the next page from the current page of result.
